palette: Neutral daylight, white/grey walls, real grey asphalt; each material retains its local color. No global cream/yellow/orange wash, no global blue shift.
neighborRole: Shared edge geometry and silhouette ONLY; never inherit neighbor palette, internal buildings or landmark set.
rules: Assign by actual parcel use and existing ground footprint; do not change source roads, parcel bounds or ground footprint. Guide heights are nominal visual framing, not a same-height mandate or new hard cap; use coherent height/massing variety while keeping roads visibly open.
Combinations are selected per parcel and per existing building using stable identity; do not impose a universal region building package. No minimum seven-type quota per 120m region.

Landscape parcels receive designed landscape, not mandatory public buildings. School/civic forms only on explicitly matching land use. Unknown source-building use stays explicit and unresolved, no invented civic use.
Differentiate silhouette, upper massing, floor rhythm, roof, facade and door organization. Recoloring repeated white boxes with orange awnings is insufficient.
No roof vegetation. Complete whole regions generated once, retain original 62.5/45 camera and three boundaries.
Assignments describe intent, never count achieved building diversity or claim acceptance.
